newsitem.title: USA: Successories Nov same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Successories Nov same-store sales rise.

text.p: Successories Inc said on Thursday its same-store sales for the four weeks ended November 30 rose 36 percent from the year-ago period.
Total sales for the month increased 44 percent, it said.
"Expectations for the holiday season remain high," said James Beltrame, president and chief operating officer, in a news release. "We fully expect to meet our goals for the holiday season."

Successories is a specialty company that designs, makes and sells motivational products. It operates about 100 retail stores. It recently changed its name from Celex Group Inc. ((--Chicago Newsdesk (312) 408-8787))
